notes: The aircraft itself uses the lightweight transient airdrop runtime; Campus 3D is not loaded merely to show the flight.
At jump time the current aerial runtime is replaced by a sector-specific proxy and only the selected destination 3D module is prefetched below the configured altitude.
The full destination world is mounted only after landing.
Space Station, Moon and Mars remain outside atmospheric airdrop and use orbital navigation.
F87 introduces no database migration when upgrading from F86.
